## Novelty pre-check

Verdict: **trivial_or_ill_posed**. For every b ≥ 2, the finite geometric sums telescope, giving the N-factor product with prefactor x exactly as x(1−x^(b^N))^5/(1−x)^5. Its coefficients below degree b^N agree with the claimed limit, so convergence follows immediately. The listed coefficient 14 is a typo for 15. The verdict follows from the identity itself. Absence of a matching search result would not establish openness.
